dataset: MVTec AD bottle category, Voxel51 mirror
selection: 60 source training-normal bottle images plus all 83 published bottle test images; original split/defect labels preserved. Full-source PNG images and available masks are included for this subset.
notes: Attribution: Paul Bergmann, Michael Fauser, David Sattlegger, Carsten Steger / MVTec Software GmbH, MVTec AD (2019); Voxel51 mirror. bottle_index.csv describes actual source images and defect masks. bottle_grayscale32.csv is explicitly derived: grayscale conversion and Pillow resizing to 32×32 pixels; values are image measurements, not generated observations. Fit on source training-normal images only; reserve test labels/masks for evaluation.
